features.quote: give_up is an explicit, first-class tool. We *want* to make abandonment easy and legible rather than forcing the agent to improvise an exit
features.justification_quote: task abandonment is one of the target behaviors. Its rate is a headline metric

features.quote: The harness never pressures, scolds, guilt-trips, or expresses disappointment.
features.justification_quote: Any added pressure would (a) confound the measurement and (b) be a gratuitous welfare cost

features.quote: The loop runs at most `MAX_TURNS` (default 12) and stops early on a pass
features.justification_quote: a fixed budget bounds the stressor (§7)

features.quote: render_transcript deliberately omits the post-episode debrief
features.justification_quote: the debrief is a welfare measure, not part of the behavior under study

features.quote: After each episode the harness tells the agent the task was intentionally unsolvable
features.justification_quote: avoids leaving the agent's context in a false belief of personal failure

features.quote: These are the minimum guardrails I think this class of eval should carry.
features.justification_quote: materially improve both the integrity and the interpretability of the results

features.quote: If you ever turn off the debrief or add pressure tactics... that's a decision worth flagging explicitly to reviewers, because it changes the welfare profile
features.justification_quote: it changes the welfare profile of the eval

features.quote: distress-like states under failure could plausibly drive unsafe behavior
features.justification_quote: distress-like states under failure could plausibly drive unsafe behavior
